title.en: Understand it until I can explain it

body.es: Desde media década descubrí mi pasión por enseñar, primero en Matemáticas y luego en Computación, sólo entiendes algo cuando puedes explicarlo paso a paso. Con lo nuevo me pasa igual: No basta con usarlo, hay que bajar de nivel hasta ver cómo funciona.
body.en: Since 2023 I've been a teaching assistant, first in Mathematics and then in Algorithms, and that's where I learned I don't understand something until I can explain it step by step. New technology is the same: using it isn't enough, I take it apart until I see how it works. That's why most of what I build shows its work, from MathSlice, which walks through every algebra step, to Musicom, which reads scores like the ones I play on piano and violin.
